notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the federation MOM synchronization query surface. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM synchronization interactions and data elements, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, application FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. It verifies active synchronization-point listing, per-federate status before and after achievement, missing-label behavior, callback subscription gating, and removal after completion. Provider-private headers, registries, file sinks, names, and diagnostics are outside this contract.

api_surfaces.owner: IEEE 1516.1 C++ API and IEEE 1516.2 standard MIM
api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador synchronization-point services with standard HLArequestSynchronizationPoints, HLArequestSynchronizationPointStatus, HLAreportSynchronizationPoints, and HLAreportSynchronizationPointStatus interactions
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 synchronization services and FederateAmbassador interaction-delivery declarations
